02 / about

I like knowing
how the whole thing works.

I’m brick — a Minecraft network owner and content creator with a habit of digging into the systems underneath whatever I’m building.

Brickworks is my own network, which means I end up moving between development, hosting and content rather than staying in one lane.

Python and Skript are where I’m most comfortable. I’m learning Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS through plugins, websites and tools I actually want to use.

Self-hosting pulled me into Linux, Docker and networking. I’d rather understand why something broke than keep restarting it and hoping.
